description: This file defines an internal class 'InterfaceToImplementationMappingCache' that maintains mappings between grain interface methods and their corresponding implementation methods in the Orleans framework. It includes data structures for storing method info, handles generic methods, and provides methods for creating and retrieving these mappings based on implementation and interface types.

classes.name: InterfaceToImplementationMappingCache
classes.description: Maintains a cache of mappings between grain interface methods and their implementation methods.

classes.name: InterfaceToImplementationMappingCache.Entry
classes.description: Immutable struct representing a pair of implementation and interface method information, with support for generic method construction.

classes.name: InterfaceToImplementationMappingCache.TypeArrayComparer
classes.description: Comparer class for comparing arrays of Type objects.

methods.name: GetOrCreate
methods.description: Returns a map from interface methods to their implementation entries for specified implementation and interface types.

methods.name: CreateInterfaceToImplementationMap
methods.description: Builds a dictionary mapping interface types to their method mappings based on the implementation type.
